name: Jentic
description: Jentic connects Claude to 10,000+ APIs through a single MCP server. Credentials never touch your prompts — Jentic's managed vault handles auth centrally. Just-In-Time Tooling means agents fetch only the tools they need, keeping context lean and reasoning accurate.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Jentic to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Jentic to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.jentic.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Jentic MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Jentic provides these MCP tools: search_apis, load_execution_info, and execute.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Jentic?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Jentic in automation-workflows on the Manufact MCP catalog include Sidewave Maggiordomo, Corsair Cloud, Fleet Workspace, Whalesync, and typenode-mcp.
Jentic requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Jentic is developed by Jentic. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
